title: Mortgage Loss-Mitigation and Foreclosure Protection Gate
tagline: The same borrower packet can create a notice duty, an evaluation duty, and a foreclosure restriction—on different facts and clocks.

cards: Submission looks like one event with one status.
Different milestones activate different duties and protections.
One day or one missing receipt can change the protected path.
Every obligation remains visible without an automated eligibility decision.

story.headline: The foreclosure case separated by one day
beats: Two borrowers submit complete applications before scheduled sales.
One arrives 38 days before sale and the other exactly 37 days before.
The agent assigns both the same paragraph protection and later treats a counsel message as a stopped sale.
The graph preserves the exact milestone, all separate duties, and every receipt stage.
